source_request: I'd like a product photo that clearly shows the fastening at the front of a bra.
interpreted_intent: The synthetic requester specifies a bra front fastening and its clear visibility, without specifying its mechanism or engagement state. I choose a compact joined clasp and face-up product arrangement, treating clasp type, closed state, charcoal fabric and framing as editable author choices. The intended image makes the front connection spatially obvious without extending the requester contract to a particular mechanism.
subject: A bra arranged as an adult-size product with its front fastening visible.
setting: A pale stone counter and warm gray wall near a high window.
event: The front fastening is displayed in its garment context.
visual_priorities: The fastening is visibly located on the garment front.
The front panels and cups establish its relation to the bra.
A restrained metal glint sets the connection apart from matte cloth.
baseline_prompt_en: A product photograph presents a bra with its front fastening clearly visible. The adult-size garment lies face-up on a pale stone counter, with both cups and the short fabric sections leading into the front connection in view. A compact clasp joins the two front panels. One side of the charcoal fabric rests in a slight fold, giving the arrangement the relaxed precision of a real garment set down for inspection. The clasp catches a restrained glint against the matte cloth. A warm gray wall falls softly out of focus behind the counter. High window light describes the seam edges and the small junction, while a close three-quarter view keeps the fastening's position on the garment immediately clear.
